description: Thresholds and markers the evolution evidence gates judge against: the recorded-input replay gate (#3517), the evidence-span gate (#1945) and the evidence-type gate (#3507). Data, not code, and pinned OUTSIDE the agent-writable tree (evolution_pinned_surface.py) so a self-edit cannot weaken the evidence gate that governs it. Byte-for-byte the constants that used to live in the three modules.
